name: Script
description: Executes custom JavaScript code on variable inputs with typed output schema.

inputs.name: input
inputs.label: Input Variable
inputs.helpText: Select an upstream variable passed as the `input` argument into run(input).

inputs.name: code
inputs.label: Script Function

inputs.name: outputType
inputs.label: Zod Output Schema
